part.text:
Fixed. In `formatter<group_digits_view<T>>::format` (include/fmt/format.h:4142), negative values were cast straight to an unsigned type, producing the two's-complement value. Now the code detects negatives via `detail::is_negative`, negates to get the absolute value, and sets the `-` sign prefix (same encoding `0x01000000 | '-'` used by `write_int`), so `fmt::group_digits(-12345)` correctly yields `-12,345`.

Verified: `format_test.group_digits_view` (including negative cases) and the full format-test and base-test suites all pass.
